headline: Transfer rumors, news: Barcelona, Liverpool, Real Madrid eye Jeltsch
description: Barcelona, Liverpool and Real Madrid are keen on VfB Stuttgart defender Finn Jeltsch. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Brentford contact police over 'dangerous' rugby ball stunt in Liverpool game
description: Brentford have contacted police following a "dangerous" and "potentially very harmful" incident which involved an "item being kicked from a height towards the field of play" in their 2-1 defeat against Liverpool.

headline: Man City's Marc Guéhi: Taking the knee may have lost its impact, more can be done
description: Manchester City defender Marc Guéhi believes the gesture of soccer players taking the knee before matches might have lost its impact and wants to see more done in the sport's fight against racism.

headline: Ronald Araújo: 'Too early' to say if Liverpool stay will become permanent
description: Ronald Araújo has said he is "really happy" to be at Liverpool but it is "too early" to say whether he will make his loan move from Barcelona permanent.

headline: Ex-England international Steven Caulker reveals toll of unemployment on LinkedIn
description: One-time England international Steven Caulker has shared his fear at facing unemployment.

headline: Who could replace Carrick after Man United's worst start since 1986?
description: Manchester United have struggled this season, but which managers could step in to replace Michael Carrick if the club sack him?
